Rime Wedge.name: Rime Wedge
Rime Wedge.description: The user slaps a frost-plated palm to the floor and drives a low ridge of stone-hardened ice up to five meters into a target. It deals cold damage and locks around the target's ankles so they cannot run or dodge until the end of their next turn; held back, it only trips them without frostbite. Fire melts the ridge at once, and the slap stiffens the user's wrist with cold. Strain: light.
